76: function MainTaskModel:FindNextTask(day, id, max)
77:   if not self.m_mapTaskData[day] or day == max.day and id == max.id then
78:     return nil
79:   end
80:   if id == 0 then
81:     if self.m_mapTaskData[day][1] then
82:       return self.m_mapTaskData[day][1]
83:     else
84:       return nil
85:     end
86:   end
87:   local tasks = self.m_mapTaskOrder[day]
88:   local currentIndex = 0
89:   for i, task in ipairs(tasks) do
90:     if tostring(task.id) == tostring(id) then
91:       currentIndex = i
92:       break
93:     end
94:   end
95:   if currentIndex == 0 then
96:     local idInfo = MainTaskData.GetIdInfo(id)
97:     if idInfo.idType == EMainTaskIdType.Pre then
98:       local baseId = idInfo.baseId
99:       if self.m_mapTaskData[day][baseId] then
100:         return self.m_mapTaskData[day][baseId]
101:       else
102:         Log.Error("MainTaskModel:FindNextTask MainTaskConfig Error, the last task of the day cannot be _pre, task" .. tostring(day) .. " " .. tostring(id), LogTag.ConfigCheck)
103:         return nil
104:       end
105:     else
106:       return nil
107:     end
108:   else
109:     if currentIndex < #tasks then
110:       return tasks[currentIndex + 1]
111:     end
112:     return self:FindNextTask(day + 1, 0, max)

443: function MainTaskModel:GetTaskCost(taskData)
444:   Log.Assert(taskData, "MainTaskModel:GetTaskCost param taskData is nil")
445:   local value = self.m_dbTable:GetValue(DBCurCost, DBColumn)
446:   if StringUtil.IsNilOrEmpty(value) then
447:     return self:GetTaskCostWithServerConfig(taskData)
448:   end
449:   local list = StringUtil.Split(value, "##")
450:   Log.Assert(#list == 2, "MainTaskModel:GetTaskCost value error " .. value)
451:   if list[1] ~= taskData:GetDBKey() then
452:     return self:GetTaskCostWithServerConfig(taskData)
453:   end
454:   return tonumber(list[2])
455: end
456: 
457: function MainTaskModel:GetTaskCostWithServerConfig(taskData, level, gold)
458:   if taskData.cost == 0 then
459:     return 0
460:   end
461:   local maxDay = self:GetMaxUnlock().day
462:   if maxDay < 0 then
463:     return taskData.cost
464:   end
465:   local ratio = 1
466:   local cfg = GM.ConfigModel:GetTaskPriceIncreaseCfg()
467:   if cfg and maxDay - taskData.day < cfg.dayLast then
468:     ratio = ratio * cfg.multiple
469:   end
470:   level = level or GM.LevelModel:GetCurrentLevel()
471:   gold = gold or GM.PropertyDataManager:GetPropertyNum(EPropertyType.Gold)
472:   ratio = ratio * self:_GetTaskGoldCostControlRatio(level, gold)
473:   return math.ceil(taskData.cost * ratio)
474: end
475: 
476: function MainTaskModel:_GetTaskGoldCostControlRatio(level, gold)
477:   if not level or not gold then
478:     return 1
479:   end
480:   local costControlTag = GM.ConfigModel:GetGeneralConfByType(EGeneralConfType.TaskGoldCostControl, ConfigModel.EGeneralConfigParam.String)
481:   if StringUtil.IsNilOrEmpty(costControlTag) then
482:     return 1
483:   end
484:   if self.m_mapTaskGoldCostArrLevelBounds == nil then
485:     GM.BIManager:LogErrorInfo(EBIType.MainTaskGoldControlError, "config missing all")
486:     return 1
487:   end
488:   if self.m_mapTaskGoldCostArrLevelBounds[costControlTag] == nil then
489:     GM.BIManager:LogErrorInfo(EBIType.MainTaskGoldControlError, "config missing " .. tostring(costControlTag))
490:     return 1
491:   end
492:   local arrLevelBounds = self.m_mapTaskGoldCostArrLevelBounds[costControlTag]
493:   local selectedLevelBound
494:   for i, levelBound in ipairs(arrLevelBounds) do
495:     if levelBound <= level then
496:       selectedLevelBound = levelBound
497:     else
498:       break
499:     end
500:   end
501:   if selectedLevelBound == nil then
502:     return 1
503:   end
504:   local arrConfig = self.m_mapTaskGoldCostConfig[costControlTag][selectedLevelBound]
505:   local selectedConfig
506:   for _, config in ipairs(arrConfig) do
507:     if gold >= config.gold_min then
508:       selectedConfig = config
509:     else
510:       break
511:     end
512:   end
513:   if selectedConfig == nil then
514:     return 1
515:   end
516:   return selectedConfig.cost_ratio / 100
517: end
